title: Door lock sudoku
lead: The lock needs the four blanks filled in. Read those four digits top to bottom, left to right, and that is the four-digit password.
hint: Each blank has only one digit missing from its row, its column and its 3×3 box.
failure: Wrong code. The four blanks stay as they are, so you can try again.
success: Sudoku passed. The lock moves on to the password.

password.lead: Sudoku passed. The lock has a second stage: a four-digit password.
password.success: Password correct. The door lock is released.
